topic: Main Application Authentication and Workspace Router
summary: Main application entry point handling theme states, offline/online capabilities, data synchronization, security locks (PIN/biometrics), and routing between marketing pages, login screens, and the core dashboard.
steps: Launch the application to view the homepage or dashboard based on your authentication status.
Click 'Continue with Google' or use custom signup/login options to authenticate.
Enter your 4-digit PIN if PIN lock is enabled to unlock your workspace.

summary: Handles user registration, login via email/phone/Google, password strength checking, OTP verification, and password reset.
steps: Select 'Sign Up' or 'Log In' from the form toggle bar.
Choose your login method: Email, Phone, or Google.
For email signup, fill out 'Your Name', 'Company Name', 'Phone Number', 'Email Address', and 'Password'.
Click 'Create Account' or 'Log In'.

summary: Screen lock security verification using a 4-digit PIN dialpad, lockout handling for failed attempts, and recovery via security questions or PIN removal.
steps: Enter your 4-digit PIN using the on-screen dialpad or keyboard numbers.
If you forget your PIN, click 'Forgot PIN?' to initiate recovery or PIN removal.

summary: Allows users to recover access to their account by answering two predefined security questions when they forget their PIN.
steps: Type your answer into the Question 1 input field
Type your answer into the Question 2 input field
Click the Verify & Reset PIN button
Click Back to PIN Entry to return to standard PIN entry
Click Remove PIN Lock instead if 3 incorrect attempts are reached

summary: Provides a 3-step walkthrough to help users master business profile setup, invoice creation, and PDF export workflows.
steps: Review Step 01 to initialize your business profile, GSTIN, and currency preferences
Review Step 02 to draft invoices, sketch signatures, and customize layouts
Review Step 03 to generate high-fidelity PDFs and print documents
Click the scroll-to-top button to return to the top of the page

summary: Main landing page featuring product highlights, interactive live preview demos, feature showcases, FAQ accordion, and user authentication forms.
steps: Click Features, Guide, Pricing, FAQ, or Contact in the navigation bar to jump to sections
Select a language from the language dropdown menu
Click Log In or Sign Up to access authentication options
Interact with the color palette, invoice layout, and invoice status buttons in the live preview panel
Click Get Started for Free to initiate registration

topic: Quick Bill / Invoice Creation and Editing Modal
summary: Modal interface to create, edit, customize, and save invoices, proformas, credit notes, estimates, purchase bills, and purchase orders with live preview and PDF generation.
steps: Select document type from the pill tabs or dropdown (Tax Invoice, Proforma, Credit Note, Quote / Est, Purchases, P.O., Debit Note).
Enter the ID Number.
Enter optional Ref Number, P.O. Number, and Delivery Note.
Select Issue Date and Due Date.
Select Status (Unpaid / Pending, Paid, Cancelled, Approved, Not Approved).
Fill in Place of Supply and GR/RR No if applicable.

Select a pre-saved client profile from 'Populate from Clients' or enter Client Name, Client Email, Client Phone, Client Physical Billing Address, Client Country, Client State, Client GSTIN / UIN, and Client PAN manually.
Fill in Shipped To Details or click 'Same as Client' to copy billing details.
Enable Transport Details toggle if required, then fill in Transport, Vehicle No., Driver Mobile, Station, and E-Way Bill No.
Add custom line items by typing Product Name, HSN Code, Size, Rate / Price, Qty, Qty Type, Product Terms, and Item Description, then click 'Add Item to draft'.
Configure Freight Charges and discount type (Percentage (%) or Flat Amount) and value if applicable.
Toggle Recurring Invoice Settings to configure billing frequency, first bill date, and ending criteria.
Enter Custom Footnotes / Payment Instructions and Invoice Terms & Conditions.
Configure tax compliance policies (Auto Regional Tax or Custom Tax Override with additional taxes).
Click 'Export PDF Direct' to download the PDF, 'Save as Draft', or click 'Save Invoice' to save to your ledger.

route: modal (triggered from settings or security screen)
summary: Modal interface to set up or disable a 4-digit PIN lock and configure recovery security questions.
steps: Use the virtual dial pad or physical keyboard to enter a 4-digit PIN.
For enable mode, re-enter your PIN to confirm.
Set up two recovery security questions on the subsequent step.
For disable mode, enter your current PIN to confirm disabling.
Click 'Cancel' to abort the operation.

summary: Displays subscription plans (Starter Free, MakInvoices Pro, Custom Enterprise) with monthly and yearly billing toggle options.
steps: Toggle between Monthly Billing and Yearly Billing using the billing switch.
Review the features for Starter, Pro, or Enterprise plans.
Click 'Start Free Trial' or 'Upgrade to Pro' to proceed to signup.
Click 'Contact Sales' to navigate to the contact page for enterprise inquiries.

summary: Public landing page navigation bar allowing users to switch languages, access public links, log in, or sign up.
steps: Click the language dropdown button to view available languages
Click Log In to go to the login page
Click Sign Up to go to the signup page

summary: Step to configure two security questions and answers for recovering your PIN passcode lock.
steps: Click the Security Question 1 dropdown to choose a question
Type your answer in the Your answer… field for the first question
Click the Security Question 2 dropdown to choose a second different question
Type your answer in the Your answer… field for the second question
Click Save & Enable PIN Lock
Click ← Back to PIN Setup to go back

summary: Configure workspace theme mode, compact layout view, and inspect invoice layout presets.
steps: Click the Dark Mode / Light Mode button to toggle workspace appearance
Click the Compact Layout toggle to enable or disable denser workspace view

summary: Manage invoice activity alerts, payment reminders, and cloud sync notification preferences.
steps: Click the Invoice Activity Alerts toggle to enable or disable
Click the Payment Reminders toggle to enable or disable
Click the Cloud Sync Alerts toggle to enable or disable

summary: Manage PIN passcode lock requirements and draft auto-save preferences.
steps: Click the Enable or Disable button next to PIN Passcode Lock
Click the Auto-Save Drafts toggle to enable or disable

summary: Export workspace data, force cloud synchronization, or clear local storage cache.
steps: Click Export All Data to download invoices, clients and settings as JSON
Click Force Cloud Sync to push local changes to the cloud
Click Clear Local Cache to remove all locally cached data
Click Yes, Clear All to confirm cache clearing, or Cancel to abort

summary: View account profile details, app version, platform environment, and sign out.
steps: Click Sign Out of Account to sign out

summary: Self-contained UI for AI Smart Billing that allows users to describe invoices in plain English and automatically fill fields in their template.
steps: Type a billing description into the smart-billing-prompt-input field
Click the Generate button or press Enter to generate invoice fields
Click the Undo2 button to revert the last AI prompt change
Click the Redo2 button to re-apply the next AI prompt change
Click the ↺ All button to regenerate and overwrite all fields

summary: Real-time multilingual support chat interface powered by MakInvoices AI with escalation to human support.
steps: Select a preferred language from the list of languages
Type a message into the input field
Click the Send button to send the message
Click the Change Language button to switch languages
Click the Talk to Human button to escalate the chat

summary: Comprehensive help and support hub featuring quick support channels, FAQs, support ticket submission, user feedback rating, and resource links.
steps: Type in the Search questions… input to search FAQs
Click on an FAQ item to expand and view its answer
Select an Issue Category button for the support ticket
Type a brief description of the issue in the Subject * input
Type a detailed description in the Detailed Description * textarea
Click the Submit Ticket button
Click a star rating button and type optional feedback, then click Submit Feedback
Click on the Getting Started Guide, Video Tutorials, or Privacy & Security Policy resources

summary: Step-by-step interactive onboarding wizard to configure workspace parameters and start billing.
steps: Click on any step button (1 to 5) to navigate through the setup wizard
Click action trigger buttons like Configure Company Info, Manage Registries, Open Template Builder, Open Sales Ledger, Open Purchases Ledger, or View Accounting Summary
Click the Previous or Next Step buttons to move between steps
Click Finish & Start Billing on the final step

summary: Step-by-step visual video guides covering dashboard navigation, template builders, tax splits, and purchases ledgers.
steps: Click on a video tutorial card to open the video player modal
Click the close ✕ button to close the video player modal

summary: Information center detailing data protection, encryption, sandbox storage, and offline-first architecture.
steps: Click the Run Diagnostics Check button to execute a security integrity check
Click the Reset Check button to reset the diagnostics state

summary: An advanced layout customizer studio that lets users fine-tune invoice templates step by step with a live preview canvas, undo/redo history, and customizable sections.
steps: Click on Undo or Redo buttons in the top header to manage template history.
Navigate through steps in the left sidebar under General & Layout, Data Sections, Financials, Footer, and Advanced Design.
Enter a custom name in the Template Name field.
Select a document type from the Document Type dropdown.
Type a description in the Description textarea.
Click Save Template to save changes.
Click Cancel to exit.
Use zoom controls or drag/pan the live preview canvas to inspect the invoice.

summary: Step-by-step wizard to quickly generate and customize invoice templates with live preview and branding options.
steps: Click Cancel to exit the wizard
Select Document Purpose by clicking on Invoice, Estimate, Proforma, Credit Note, Purchases, Purchase Order, or Purchase Debit Note
Click Next or Back to navigate between wizard steps
Select Base Template Style: Modern, Corporate, Minimal, or Premium

Configure Brand Customization by checking 'Reserve space for corporate logo', entering a Theme Accent Color, choosing Primary Typography from the dropdown, and selecting Invoice Title Position (Left, Center, Right)
Selectable Sections: Toggle checkboxes for Company, Customer (Bill To), Ship To, Gst, Transport, Payment, Qr Code, Signature, Terms, and Notes
Itemized Grid Layout: Select between Compact, Standard, and Detailed View
On the final step, click 'Save Template' or 'Go Advanced Studio', or click 'Finish'

summary: Drag and drop canvas settings to reorder sections and toggle their visibility using the eye icon.
steps: Drag sections using the grip handle to reorder them on the canvas
Click the eye icon to show or hide a section completely

summary: Comprehensive configuration controls for document type, layout, header, company info, tax, payment, transport, terms, and signature settings.
steps: Select Category Theme Preset from the dropdown (User Custom, GST Standard, Service, Retail, Default Standard)
Select Document Type from the dropdown (Invoice (Tax Invoice), Credit Note, Proforma Invoice, Quote / Estimate, Purchases (Purchase Bill), Purchase Order, Purchase Debit Note)
Select Layout Type from the dropdown (Classic, Modern, Minimal, Corporate, GST Standard, Retail, Modal Classic, Fully Custom)
Select Page Size (A4, Letter)
Check 'Enable Watermark' and enter Watermark Text and Opacity (0.1 to 1)
Check 'Show Logo' and select Logo Position (Left, Center, Right)
Enter Logo Width (px)
Enter Invoice Title / Heading and select Title Alignment
Check company field options to show OWNER / CONTACT PERSON, EMAIL, PHONE, ADDRESS, STATE, COUNTRY, GSTIN, PAN, or WEBSITE
Check invoice meta fields to show Invoice No., Dated, Due Date, Place of Supply, GR/RR No., Ref. No., PO Number, or Delivery Note
Select Block Alignment for invoice info (Left, Center, Right)
Check fields to display for Bill To section (NAME, ADDRESS, GSTIN, PAN, PHONE, EMAIL)
Check fields to display for Ship To section (NAME, ADDRESS, GSTIN, PAN, PHONE, EMAIL)
Manage columns for product table by checking or unchecking visibility and editing column labels
Configure tax breakdown options: Show Taxable Amount, Show CGST & SGST (If Local), Show IGST (If Interstate), Show Grand Total, Enable Breakdown Block
Check 'Generate QR Code for UPI automatically' and enter Custom Payment Note
Configure design settings: set Primary Color, Table Header Background, check 'Use Rounded Corners', and 'Alternating Table Row Colors'
Select fields to display for Transport section: Vehicle No, Driver Mobile, E-Way Bill No, Transport Name, Station, GR/RR No.
Check 'Enable Amount in Words' and select Format (Indian, International)
Enter Notes / Greetings and Terms & Conditions
Check 'Show Signature Block', 'Show Stamp Area', and enter Signatory Name and Designation
Configure footer settings: check 'Show Page Numbers', enter Footer Message, and toggle 'Show Contact (Email & Phone)' and 'Show Website'

summary: Selection hub to choose between the Quick Guided Builder wizard and the Advanced Studio Editor for invoice templates.
steps: Click Back to Library
Click Quick Guided Builder
Click Advanced Studio Editor

summary: Central manager to view, sort, search, and manage custom and system invoice template presets.
steps: Click New Template
Click My Templates
Click System Presets
Type Search templates...
Click All
Click Invoice
Click Proforma Invoice
Click Debit Note
Click Credit Note
Click Quote
Click Purchase Order
Click Purchases
Click View Details

summary: Modal displaying a full preview and specifications of a selected template, with options to edit, duplicate, set as default, export PDF, or delete.
steps: Click Edit Template
Click Use This Preset
Click Set Default
Click Duplicate
Click PDF
Click Delete

summary: Manage and create standard tax invoices, view GST split breakdowns, vehicles shipping details, and auto-generate scan-to-pay QR codes.
steps: Navigate to the Sales Ledger under Invoices.
Select the Tax Invoices subsection.
Click Create Invoice or Quick Bill.
Add client, product line items, and applicable taxes.

summary: Draft and manage proforma invoices for customers. Proforma invoices use the default proforma prefix and number sequence.
steps: Navigate to the Sales Ledger under Invoices.
Select the Proforma Invoices subsection.
Click Create Proforma Invoice.
Fill out items and save as proforma draft or final document.

summary: Issue credit notes for sales returns, product damages, adjustments, or billing write-offs.
steps: Navigate to the Sales Ledger under Invoices.
Select the Credit Notes subsection.
Click Create Credit Note.
Enter items being returned or values being adjusted, select original invoice reference, and save.

summary: Draft quotations and price estimates for prospective clients. These do not count as finalized accounting transactions.
steps: Navigate to the Sales Ledger under Invoices.
Select the Quotes & Estimates subsection.
Click Create Quote.
Enter product estimates, select customer, customize template styling, and download as PDF.

summary: Track incoming tax invoices and bills from suppliers to monitor spending.
steps: Navigate to the Purchases Ledger under Purchases.
Select the Purchase Bills subsection.
Click Create Purchase Bill.
Select vendor, enter items and tax rates, and log purchase amount.

summary: Issue purchase orders (PO) to vendors to request goods or services under agreed terms.
steps: Navigate to the Purchases Ledger under Purchases.
Select the Purchase Orders subsection.
Click Create Purchase Order.
Select vendor, add items and quantities, set delivery terms, and download/email PO.

summary: Issue debit notes to document purchase returns, damaged goods returned to suppliers, or cost adjustments.
steps: Navigate to the Purchases Ledger.
Select the Debit Notes subsection.
Click Create Debit Note.
Enter the returned items and adjustment details, choose vendor, and save.

summary: View and manage supplier profiles automatically generated from finalized purchase bills, POs, and debit notes.
steps: Go to the Billed Vendors tab in the sidebar.
Search for specific suppliers or view their total billing history.
Click edit to update supplier contact info or tax numbers.

summary: Comprehensive step-by-step user guide walkthrough for setting up company profiles, master registries, designing templates, managing ledgers, exporting reports, and enabling PIN security.
steps: Select 'Learn MakInvoices' under Tools & Design in the sidebar menu.
Read the Part A Structural Walkthrough modules to set up business profile, registries, templates, ledgers, reports, and security PIN.
Check Part B Company Policies for billing standardizations, logo sizing, bank account protocols, tax structures, and backup requirements.

topic: Learn MakInvoices - Quick Utilities and Tips
summary: Quick tips, keyboard shortcuts, and auditing protocols for invoicing efficiency.
steps: Select 'Learn MakInvoices' in the sidebar.
Locate the Quick Utilities card in the sidebar of the page.
Learn keyboard controls (e.g. Ctrl+P for printing), sidebar toggles, and tax auditing protocols.

summary: Quick references, answer cards, and troubleshooting steps for commonly asked billing, tax, sync, security, templates, and catalog questions.
steps: Navigate to the Help & Support page from the sidebar.
Type in the search bar to locate specific questions.
Click on any FAQ category tabs (Billing, Technical, Account, Feature).
Click on a question to expand and view the detailed answer.
